auditRule: Each page has one primary job, one authoritative renderer/data owner, explicit public/workspace boundary, and contextual handoffs that do not transfer evidence claims.

pages.label: Market Command
pages.job: Default market orientation and current market command surface
pages.owner: production public-runtime Market V6 after finalization
pages.coherence: Entry surface; does not duplicate Decision or Search.

pages.label: Decision Intelligence
pages.job: Evidence-gated research view, scenarios, setup/invalidation and explanation
pages.coherence: Receives asset/timeframe context; hands context to Formula and Qelly Chat.

pages.label: Formula Screener
pages.job: Deterministic quantitative ranking over declared market-candle method
pages.coherence: Consumes research asset/timeframe only for selection/handoff; formula sampling interval remains independently declared.

pages.label: Asset Dossier
pages.job: Single supported asset market evidence review
pages.owner: app.js renderAsset + public market asset endpoints
pages.coherence: Canonical Search destination; explicit Decision, Formula and Chat continuation.

pages.label: Qelly Chat & Research
pages.job: Grounded conversational research over QELLY tools/evidence
pages.coherence: Reads navigation context but re-grounds current claims; no inherited evidence claim.

pages.label: Universal Search
pages.job: Deterministic exact retrieval across product/formula/indicator/asset catalog
pages.coherence: Asset hits deep-link canonical Asset Dossier ID; Search performs no analysis.

pages.label: India Finance & SIP
pages.job: India finance reference evidence and deterministic finance tools

pages.label: Alert Rules
pages.job: Alert-rule surface with explicit capability boundary

pages.label: Qelly Verify
pages.coherence: Verification does not become Decision probability or execution.

pages.label: Quant Calculator Center
pages.coherence: Routes to hidden public calculator-detail pages.

pages.label: Calculator Detail
pages.job: Run one registered deterministic calculator with declared inputs/formula
pages.owner: calculator-detail.mjs in source; calculator-detail-v6.mjs in finalized connected production
pages.coherence: No generative arithmetic fallback; build-time ownership is classified, not deleted.

flow.evidenceBoundary: Handoff state is navigation context only. No result, probability, eligibility, price, or provider observation is trusted across surfaces without the destination's own evidence/tool contract.

status: Wave Z coherence delta implemented; exact-head CI/browser acceptance required before merge.
